what: Embed the Pi Coding Agent in R
title: Embed the Pi Coding Agent in R
text: way embed Pi coding agent R. Drive live agent R small scripting API — pi_run() one turn, pi_session() memory-keeping multi-turn session — drop straight R Markdown / Quarto knitr engines run live agent (fail-loud shell commands) render time, weaving agent’s real replies command output document. Rendering becomes integration test: stale claim broken command fails build. idea leanknit duckknit, pointed agent. Two ways use : R binding — pi_run() / pi_session() call Pi agent R script, app, pipeline; agent (tools extensions) becomes function call whose reply keep. literate engines — ```{pi} ```{pish} chunks put live agent fail-loud commands rendered document.

title: Embed the Pi Coding Agent in R
text: pi’s --mode rpc emits JSON events happen, pi_stream() delivers reply incrementally — assistant text deltas, every event callback — ending pi’s agent_end:
code: pi_stream("Explain content-addressed storage in two sentences.")          # prints as it is typed pi_stream("...", on_event = function(ev) if (ev$type == "turn_end") message("done"))

title: Embed the Pi Coding Agent in R
text: pi_session() gives successive turns shared conversation memory (via stable --session-id) without holding long-lived process, earlier chunk’s result scope later:
code: s <- pi_session(dir = "~/pi-bio-agent", extension = "extensions/pi-coding-agent/index.ts") s$ask("Load examples/variant-counts/manifest.json and count variants by consequence.") s$ask("Now express the same counts as percentages.")  # remembers the table above

title: Run one turn of a live Pi agent — pi_run
text: prompt user prompt (single string). model Model pattern ID. Defaults getOption("piknit.model"), "gpt-5.3-codex-spark" — small, fast model keeps live turn seconds, whole document renders real integration test. provider Provider id. Defaults getOption("piknit.provider"), "openai-codex". extension Optional character vector extension entrypoints, passed repeated -e flags (e.g. Pi coding-agent extension exposes tools). no_extensions TRUE, disable extension discovery loading explicit extension entrypoints. session Optional session id. set, turns share id share conversation memory (persistent session across chunks); NULL (default) turn ephemeral (---session). See pi_session(). thinking Optional thinking level (e.g. "high"), models support . timeout Seconds turn killed (default 300). dir Project root start agent (working directory). pi treats working directory project root, dir scopes agent's file tools, extension/skill/manifest paths resolved relative . working directory restored afterwards. NULL (default) runs current directory. pi_bin Path pi binary (default resolves piknit.bin / PIKNIT_PI / "pi").

what: Stream a live Pi agent turn as it happens — pi_stream
title: Stream a live Pi agent turn as it happens — pi_stream
text: Runs one agent turn pi's JSON-RPC mode (pi --mode rpc) delivers output incrementally produced, instead waiting whole turn like pi_run(). Assistant text arrives deltas (streamed on_delta default), every parsed event available on_event tool-call, thinking, lifecycle handling. turn ends pi's agent_end event. Needs suggested packages processx jsonlite.

title: Stream a live Pi agent turn as it happens — pi_stream
code: pi_stream(   prompt,   model = NULL,   provider = NULL,   extension = NULL,   session = NULL,   thinking = NULL,   timeout = 300,   dir = NULL,   on_delta = function(text) cat(text),   on_event = NULL,   pi_bin = .pi_bin() )

title: Stream a live Pi agent turn as it happens — pi_stream
text: prompt user prompt (single string). model Model pattern ID. Defaults getOption("piknit.model"), "gpt-5.3-codex-spark" — small, fast model keeps live turn seconds, whole document renders real integration test. provider Provider id. Defaults getOption("piknit.provider"), "openai-codex". extension Optional character vector extension entrypoints, passed repeated -e flags (e.g. Pi coding-agent extension exposes tools). session Optional session id. set, turns share id share conversation memory (persistent session across chunks); NULL (default) turn ephemeral (---session). See pi_session(). thinking Optional thinking level (e.g. "high"), models support . timeout Seconds turn killed (default 300). dir Project root start agent (working directory). pi treats working directory project root, dir scopes agent's file tools, extension/skill/manifest paths resolved relative . working directory restored afterwards. NULL (default) runs current directory. on_delta Function called chunk assistant text streams (default writes console cat()). NULL suppresses live output. on_event Optional function called every parsed JSON event (named list), e.g. react message_update tool calls turn_end. pi_bin Path pi binary (default resolves piknit.bin / PIKNIT_PI / "pi").

title: piknit 0.1.0
text: pi knitr engine — chunk body prompt; live Pi agent turn runs render time real reply woven blockquote, exact command used. Chunk options model, provider, extension, session, thinking, timeout honoured; default model small, fast gpt-5.3-codex-spark live turn seconds, minutes. pish knitr engine — run shell command fail-loud: non-zero exit stops render (never bakes failure answer), JSON output fenced json syntax highlighting.

title: piknit 0.1.0
text: pi_run() — one non-interactive agent turn, returned pi_reply. dir argument sets project root agent starts (pi treats working directory project root, scoping file tools relative paths). pi_stream() — stream turn pi --mode rpc: assistant text arrives deltas (on_delta callback) every parsed event on_event; turn ends pi’s agent_end. Uses processx + jsonlite (suggested). pi_reply — S3 class (character lines + prompt/model attributes) print() method writes reply plainly, renders agent wrote console, script, knitr chunk — quoted vector. pi_session() — persistent session whose ask() turns share conversation memory via stable --session-id, without holding long-lived process. wrap_prompt() — wrap long prompt onto short, still-runnable shell lines. register_engines() — (re)register engines knitr.
